title: halimium atriplicifolium subsp. macrocalycinum
intro: Halimium atriplicifolium subsp. macrocalycinum, commonly known as the 'tree limonium', is a type of flowering plant in the Cistaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Halimium atriplicifolium subsp. macrocalycinum include its ability to soothe and calm irritated tissues, as well as its potential to support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
